# Corsizio

> Corsizio is an event registration and class management platform powering bookings for local instructors, studios, and community organizations offering hands-on workshops, fitness classes, training courses, and recreational activities.

The platform serves diverse providers including Butterfly Yoga, We Do Tennis Coaching, Insight Firearms Training, Liberty Arts, and numerous dance studios, makerspaces, and community centers across locations like Lexington KY, Durham NC, Catonsville MD, and Manchester UK. Events range from children's fitness and creative workshops to professional training and volunteer opportunities.

## Key Topics

- event registration
- class booking
- firearms training
- concealed carry courses
- yoga classes
- children's fitness
- hands-on workshops
- beginner-friendly classes
- dance instruction
- tennis coaching
- creative arts workshops
- community events
- volunteer opportunities
- private lessons
- mindfulness programs
